{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Zidth''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by an intergalactic [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] ring. Posing as a [[Mriss/Legends|Mrissi]] science [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''Zidth'' landed in the [[Adsila Rifts]] to conduct geological studies. However, their true purpose was to enslave members of the [[Asilyr]] tribe as their hypersensitivity to ground tremors made them ideal slaves to work in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
